shared_elements: figures with arms extended toward objects
panels/bands of writing-like signs accompanying the figures
seated or standing figure with offering/vessel-like objects before it
figural scene occupying upper portion with sign-panels below/beside
low-relief carving on an upright slab format
justification: Both surfaces are upright commemorative slabs combining profile human figures with objects/offerings and adjacent registers of script-like signs, and in both a principal figure extends an arm toward objects placed before it, a reasonably specific convention. However, A shows a single dominant large figure with parasol-like attribute, subsidiary small figures below and vertical boxed sign-panels rendered in bold rounded high relief, whereas B shows a symmetrical pair of figures confronting each other across a laden offering table above horizontal ruled lines of text, drawn in thin, flat, schematic incised outline.
